reason_for_v2: V1 runner used namespace|order|seed|index and namespace|flip|seed|cue|index, while V1 text omitted the order and flip domain separators. V1 result is exploratory, not a protocol-conformant pass. V2 freezes the actual label-blind selector before fresh data are generated.
inheritance: Use V1 conditions, arms, interventions, acceptance, resource budgets and stop rules unchanged. Override only fresh identity and the exact SHA selector descriptions below.

exact_selection_rules.training_order: SHA-256 of namespace|order|seed|original training-row index; lexicographic ascending digest order.
exact_selection_rules.corruption: Within each B cue, SHA-256 of namespace|flip|seed|B cue|permuted episode index; lexicographic ascending digest order. Flip exactly 0, 16 or 32 of 64 occurrences per cue.
